document_notes: The page contains the continuation of the entry for L. Attidius Cornelianus (PIR² A 1341) at the top, followed by entries 1342 to 1348.
Only the continuation of the entry for L. Attidius Cornelianus (A 1341) is relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus, as he is explicitly attested as legatus Augusti pro praetore of Arabia and Syria.
